gates.notes: Reproduced identically to the prior gate run on this branch (head 13d94d41f): fails only via `npm run` on this machine because npm's script-shell resolves to cmd.exe (`npm config get script-shell` -> null -> cmd.exe default), which does not treat the single-quoted, semicolon-delimited --onlyAllow list as one token, so license-checker sees a truncated allow list and rejects the first-scanned package (@adobe/css-tools@4.5.0, MIT). This is an environment/script-shell quoting defect on Windows, not a licensing violation introduced by this branch, but the command fails verbatim as specified in the guide, so it is reported as FAIL per the literal Fail criterion.

Authoritative isolated re-run (not concurrent with other gates). Single failure: src/components/appLevel/ToasterAnnouncer/__tests__/modalSurfaces.guard.test.ts > 'recognises the surfaces that already carry the host'. Root cause: the guard test builds relative paths with Node's path.relative(), which yields backslash separators on Windows (e.g. 'components\\Popup\\Popup.tsx'), then asserts against a hardcoded forward-slash literal, so it can never match on a Windows checkout. Not touched by this branch's diff (git diff origin/main...HEAD excludes this file); pre-existing, OS-specific test bug, identical to the diagnosis recorded in the prior gate run on this branch. Note: an earlier attempt that ran this gate concurrently with the integration gate additionally surfaced 2 flaky timeouts in src/pages/integrations/components/SettingsForm/__tests__/SettingsForm.autoFill.test.tsx (resource contention under concurrent load); those did not reproduce when the file was re-run in isolation, so they are not counted here — this record reflects the clean, isolated run.

UI surface changed (src/components/form/Autocomplete/Autocomplete.tsx, src/components/form/Autocomplete/ptPreset.ts, src/pages/dataSources/components/__tests__/DataSourceTypeSelector.test.tsx match ui_globs) but no configured UI test script (`test:ui`) exists in package.json; browser verification is a separate caller decision.

Self-skip: script printed '[sonar-local] Skipping Sonar scan because SONAR_TOKEN is not set.' and exited 0 without scanning. Requires SONAR_TOKEN to be set locally (and network access to the SonarQube server) to run for real; this environment has neither configured. CI still owes this check.
